name: buyer-invoice
title: Tax invoice
for_each: select i.id, i.ref || ' ' || b.name as name from invoices i join clients b on b.id = i.buyer_id

sections.title: Invoice
sections.sql: select i.ref as invoice, b.name as buyer, s.name as sale, i.issued_on, i.due_on from invoices i join clients b on b.id = i.buyer_id join sales s on s.id = i.sale_id where i.id = $1

sections.title: Lots
sections.sql: select l.lot_number, l.title, l.hammer_cents, r.currency from lots l join invoices i on i.sale_id = l.sale_id and i.buyer_id = l.buyer_id join sales s on s.id = i.sale_id join salerooms r on r.id = s.saleroom_id where i.id = $1 and l.status = 'sold' order by l.lot_number

sections.title: Amount due
sections.note: GST is charged on the buyer's premium and any storage. Lots are released once the invoice is paid in full.
sections.sql: select i.hammer_cents, i.premium_cents, i.gst_cents, i.storage_cents, i.total_cents, coalesce((select sum(p.amount_cents) from payments p where p.invoice_id = i.id), 0)::bigint as paid_cents, i.total_cents - coalesce((select sum(p.amount_cents) from payments p where p.invoice_id = i.id), 0)::bigint as owing_cents, i.currency from invoices i where i.id = $1

name: vendor-settlement
title: Vendor settlement statement
for_each: select st.id, st.ref || ' ' || v.name as name from settlements st join consignments c on c.id = st.consignment_id join clients v on v.id = c.vendor_id where st.status <> 'draft'

sections.title: Settlement
sections.sql: select st.ref, v.name as vendor, nullif(v.gst_number, '') as vendor_gst_number, c.ref as consignment, s.name as sale, s.sale_date, st.status, st.due_on, st.paid_on from settlements st join consignments c on c.id = st.consignment_id join clients v on v.id = c.vendor_id join sales s on s.id = st.sale_id where st.id = $1

sections.title: Lots sold
sections.sql: select l.lot_number, l.title, sl.hammer_cents, sl.commission_cents, sl.fees_cents, sl.royalty_cents, st.currency from settlement_lines sl join lots l on l.id = sl.lot_id join settlements st on st.id = sl.settlement_id where sl.settlement_id = $1 order by l.lot_number

sections.title: Your account
sections.note: The artist resale royalty is deducted where the law makes the seller liable, and paid by us to the collecting agency.
sections.sql: select hammer_cents, -commission_cents as commission_cents, -fees_cents as lot_fees_cents, -gst_cents as gst_on_commission_and_fees_cents, -royalty_cents as artist_resale_royalty_cents, net_cents as paid_to_you_cents, lots_held, currency from settlements where id = $1

name: consignment-receipt
title: Consignment receipt
for_each: select c.id, c.ref || ' ' || v.name as name from consignments c join clients v on v.id = c.vendor_id

sections.title: Received from
sections.sql: select c.ref as consignment, v.name as vendor, v.email, c.received_on, c.agreement_signed_on, coalesce(c.commission_bps, (select value from settings where key = 'default_commission_bps')) as commission_bps, c.lot_fee_cents, c.settlement_days, r.currency from consignments c join clients v on v.id = c.vendor_id join salerooms r on r.id = c.saleroom_id where c.id = $1

sections.title: Lots
sections.sql: select l.ref as lot, l.title, l.artist, l.low_estimate_cents, l.high_estimate_cents, l.reserve_cents, l.location, r.currency from lots l join consignments c on c.id = l.consignment_id join salerooms r on r.id = c.saleroom_id where l.consignment_id = $1 order by l.ref
